concepts.name: Stima bayesiana (apprendimento bayesiano)
concepts.nameEn: Bayesian estimation (termed also as Bayesian learning)

concepts.name: Visione ML: θ fisso ma ignoto
concepts.nameEn: In ML methods, we view the true parameter vector θ we seek to be fixed

concepts.name: Visione bayesiana: θ variabile aleatoria
concepts.nameEn: In Bayesian learning, we consider θ to be a random variable

concepts.name: I dati di training convertono il prior in densità a posteriori
concepts.nameEn: Training data allows us to convert a distribution on this variable into a posterior probability density

concepts.name: Campo di applicabilità: densità ignota parametrizzabile
concepts.nameEn: Bayesian estimation can be applied to any situation in which the unknown density can be parameterized

concepts.name: Ipotesi 1: forma di p(x|θ) nota, valore di θ non noto esattamente
concepts.nameEn: Known density form: the form of the density p(x|θ) is assumed to be known, but the value of the parameter vector θ is not known exactly

concepts.name: Ipotesi 2: la conoscenza iniziale è in una densità a priori nota p(θ)
concepts.nameEn: Prior knowledge: our initial knowledge about θ is assumed to be contained in a known a priori density p(θ)

concepts.name: Ipotesi 3: il resto della conoscenza è nei N campioni indipendenti
concepts.nameEn: Independently drawn samples: the rest of our knowledge about θ is contained in a set X of N samples drawn independently according to the unknown probability density p(x)

concepts.name: Densità a posteriori p(θ|X) e speranza di un picco stretto sul valore vero
concepts.nameEn: The third assumption can be converted into a posterior density p(θ|X), which we hope is sharply peaked about the true value of θ

concepts.name: Obiettivo: calcolare p(x|X) il più vicino possibile a p(x)
concepts.nameEn: The goal is to compute p(x|X), which is as close as possible to p(x)

concepts.name: Passo 1: marginalizzazione sul parametro
concepts.nameEn: p(x|X) = ∫ p(x,θ|X) dθ

concepts.name: L'integrazione si estende all'intero spazio dei parametri
concepts.nameEn: The integration extends over the entire parameter space

concepts.name: Passo 2: fattorizzazione della congiunta con il teorema di Bayes
concepts.nameEn: By using Bayes theorem: p(x|X) = ∫ p(x|θ,X) p(θ|X) dθ

concepts.name: Passo 3: noto θ, la distribuzione di x è completamente nota
concepts.nameEn: The distribution of x is completely known once we know the value of the parameter vector θ

concepts.name: Formula chiave della stima bayesiana
concepts.nameEn: p(x|X) = ∫ p(x|θ) p(θ|X) dθ

concepts.name: Interpretazione: media di p(x|θ) su tutti i possibili valori di θ
concepts.nameEn: Bayesian estimation directs us to average p(x|θ) over all possible values of θ

concepts.name: I campioni influenzano p(x|X) solo attraverso la posterior
concepts.nameEn: The available observations X exert their influence on p(x|X) through the posterior probability density p(θ|X)

concepts.name: Il problema base del Bayesian learning: calcolare p(θ|X)
concepts.nameEn: The basic problem in Bayesian learning is to compute the posterior density p(θ|X)

concepts.name: Posterior dalla formula di Bayes
concepts.nameEn: From Bayes formula: p(θ|X) = p(X|θ) p(θ) / ∫ p(X|θ) p(θ) dθ

concepts.name: Il denominatore p(X): integrale che normalizza la posterior
concepts.nameEn: p(X) = ∫ p(X|θ) p(θ) dθ (normalization)

concepts.name: Verosimiglianza come produttoria (ipotesi di indipendenza)
concepts.nameEn: From independence assumption: p(X|θ) = ∏ p(x_k|θ)

concepts.name: Esempio gaussiano univariato: impostazione (solo μ ignota)
concepts.nameEn: Bayesian estimation: univariate Gaussian case

concepts.name: Modello dei dati: p(x|μ) ~ N(μ,σ²)
concepts.nameEn: Accordingly, p(x|μ) ~ N(μ,σ²)

concepts.name: Prior gaussiano sulla media: p(μ) ~ N(μ0,σ0²)
concepts.nameEn: Further assumption: p(μ) ~ N(μ0,σ0²) whose parameters are a priori known

concepts.name: Posterior come prodotto normalizzato: il fattore α
concepts.nameEn: p(μ|X) = α ∏ p(x_k|μ) p(μ), with α normalization factor

concepts.name: Forma esponenziale della posterior: esponente quadratico in μ
concepts.nameEn: p(μ|X) = α'' exp{−½[(N/σ² + 1/σ0²)μ² − 2((1/σ²)Σx_k + μ0/σ0²)μ]}

concepts.name: La posterior è ancora una densità normale
concepts.nameEn: p(μ|X) is again a normal density: p(μ|X) ~ N(μN,σN²)

concepts.name: Media a posteriori μN
concepts.nameEn: μN = (Nσ0²/(Nσ0²+σ²)) X̄ + (σ²/(Nσ0²+σ²)) μ0

concepts.name: Varianza a posteriori σN²
concepts.nameEn: σN² = σ0²σ² / (Nσ0²+σ²)

concepts.name: Media campionaria X̄
concepts.nameEn: Sample mean

concepts.name: Nota: informazione a priori e informazione empirica si combinano
concepts.nameEn: These equations show how the prior information is combined with the empirical information in the samples to obtain the a posteriori density

concepts.name: Caso limite N = 0: la media a posteriori è la media a priori
concepts.nameEn: When no samples are available (N = 0): μN = μ0

concepts.name: Caso limite N → ∞: la media a posteriori tende alla media campionaria
concepts.nameEn: When the number of samples tends to infinity: μN converges to the sample mean, the information from the data dominates the prior

concepts.name: Varianza a posteriori che tende a zero e delta di Dirac
concepts.nameEn: The posterior distribution converges to a Dirac delta function centered at the sample mean, meaning the posterior variance σN² → 0

concepts.name: Bayesian learning: il comportamento di apprendimento
concepts.nameEn: Bayesian learning

concepts.name: Figura: posterior p(μ|x1,...,xN) per N = 1, 5, 10, 20, 30
concepts.nameEn: Plot of p(μ|x1,...,xN) for increasing N

concepts.name: L'influenza del prior diminuisce al crescere di N
concepts.nameEn: The influence of the prior diminishes

concepts.name: Densità predittiva nel caso gaussiano: l'integrale da calcolare
concepts.nameEn: Having obtained the a posteriori density for the mean p(μ|X), all that remains is to obtain the desired density p(x|X)

concepts.name: Sostituzione delle due gaussiane nell'integrale
concepts.nameEn: Substituting the two Gaussian densities in the integral

concepts.name: Risultato dell'integrazione: gaussiana in x per un fattore f(σ,σN)
concepts.nameEn: p(x|X) = (1/(2πσσN)) exp[−½ (x−μN)²/(σ²+σN²)] f(σ,σN)

concepts.name: Il fattore f(σ,σN): non dipende da x
concepts.nameEn: f(σ,σN)

concepts.name: Densità predittiva: p(x|X) ~ N(μN, σ²+σN²)
concepts.nameEn: This means that p(x|X) ~ N(μN, σ²+σN²)

concepts.name: «and thus μ = μN»: la media inferita dalla distribuzione stimata
concepts.nameEn: and thus μ = μN since p(x|μ) ~ N(μ,σ²)

concepts.name: Varianza predittiva: variabilità intrinseca più incertezza sul parametro
concepts.nameEn: The variance σ²+σN² incorporates both the inherent variance σ² and the uncertainty in the estimate of μ

concepts.name: Riepilogo del caso gaussiano
concepts.nameEn: In summary

concepts.name: Overfitting

concepts.nameEn: wrong assumptions in model selection

concepts.name: Causa 2: errori di stima con un numero finito di campioni
concepts.nameEn: estimation errors due to the finite number of training samples for high-dimensional observations (overfitting)

concepts.name: Soluzione 1: ridurre la dimensionalità

concepts.name: Soluzione 2: semplificare la stima

concepts.name: Obiettivo 1: minimizzare il costo di implementazione

concepts.name: Obiettivo 2: ridurre il carico computazionale del classificatore

concepts.name: PCA: la proiezione che rappresenta meglio i dati

concepts.nameEn: Frequently used in pattern recognition and signal/image processing applications

concepts.name: Obiettivo della PCA: il sottospazio m-dimensionale con minimo errore di ricostruzione
concepts.nameEn: Given x1, x2, …, xN ∈ ℜ^n, find an m-dimensional subspace where the reconstruction error of xi is minimized

concepts.name: Criterio J_m dell'errore di ricostruzione ai minimi quadrati
concepts.nameEn: Criterion function for the reconstruction error in the least-squares sense

concepts.name: Basi φ_k (colonne di Φ) e proiezioni y_i, y_ik
concepts.nameEn: φ1, …, φm are the bases for the subspace (stored as the columns of Φ) and yi is the projection of xi onto that subspace

concepts.name: Ricostruzione x̂_i e residuo ortogonale
concepts.nameEn: Reconstruction of xi in the subspace

concepts.name: Minimo errore di ricostruzione = massima varianza proiettata
concepts.nameEn: Best represents the data by maximizing variance in a least-squares sense

concepts.name: Teorema: J_m è minimo con gli m autovettori di S di autovalore massimo
concepts.nameEn: Jm is minimized when φ1, …, φm are the m eigenvectors of the scatter matrix having the largest eigenvalues

concepts.name: Matrice di scatter S e vettore medio m
concepts.nameEn: Scatter matrix S = Σ (xi − m)(xi − m)^t

concepts.name: Nota: S è N−1 volte la matrice di covarianza Σ
concepts.nameEn: Nota: S is N−1 times the covariance matrix Σ

concepts.name: Decomposizione agli autovalori ed equazione caratteristica
concepts.nameEn: Eigen Decomposition; characteristic equation det(S − λI) = 0

concepts.name: Componenti principali: i coefficienti y
concepts.nameEn: The coefficients y = (y1, …, ym)^t are called the principal components

concepts.name: Autovettori = direzioni di massima varianza, autovalori = varianza catturata
concepts.nameEn: Eigenvectors indicate the directions that maximize variance; eigenvalues represent the amount of variance captured along each eigenvector

concepts.name: Ordinamento: la prima componente porta la varianza massima
concepts.nameEn: When the eigenvectors are sorted in descending order of the eigenvalues, the greatest variance lies on the first principal component

concepts.name: Le componenti principali sono scorrelate
concepts.nameEn: Principal components are uncorrelated (diagonal covariance)

concepts.name: Pochi autovalori grandi: segnale nel sottospazio, rumore nel resto
concepts.nameEn: Often there will be just a few large eigenvalues: the m-dimensional subspace contains the signal and the remaining n−m dimensions generally contain noise

concepts.name: Errore minimo = somma degli autovalori scartati; varianza conservata e scelta di m
concepts.nameEn: Minimum reconstruction error equals the sum of the discarded eigenvalues

concepts.nameEn: Step 3: Computation of covariance matrix Σ

concepts.name: Funzioni discriminanti g_i(x): definizione
concepts.nameEn: Discriminant functions g_i(x), i = 1, 2, ..., C

concepts.name: Regola di decisione con i discriminanti: vince il g_i più grande
concepts.nameEn: Decision rule: assign x to class ω_i if g_i(x) > g_j(x) for all j ≠ i

concepts.name: Il discriminante come punteggio assegnato a ogni classe
concepts.nameEn: The discriminant function assigns a score to each class

concepts.name: Regioni di decisione e confini di decisione
concepts.nameEn: Decision regions (ℜ1, ..., ℜC) separated by decision boundaries

concepts.name: Discriminante del classificatore a rischio condizionale minimo
concepts.nameEn: Discriminant for the classifier that minimizes conditional risk: g_i(x) = −R(α_i|x)

concepts.name: Discriminante del classificatore a errore minimo
concepts.nameEn: Discriminant for the classifier that minimizes error: g_i(x) = P(ω_i|x)

concepts.name: Punteggio del criterio ML
concepts.nameEn: Maximum Likelihood (ML) score: g_i(x) = p(x|ω_i)

concepts.name: Punteggio del criterio MAP
concepts.nameEn: Maximum A Posteriori (MAP) score: g_i(x) = p(x|ω_i)P(ω_i)

concepts.name: Nota: i risultati non cambiano con una funzione monotona crescente
concepts.nameEn: Nota: results do not change if every g_i(x) is replaced by f(g_i(x)), f monotonically increasing (e.g., logarithm)

concepts.name: Non unicità: forme equivalenti del discriminante a errore minimo
concepts.nameEn: Equivalent minimum-error-rate discriminants: P(ω_i|x), p(x|ω_i)P(ω_i), ln p(x|ω_i) + ln P(ω_i)

concepts.name: Dal rischio minimo all'errore minimo: con loss 0-1 le due definizioni coincidono
concepts.nameEn: With zero-one loss, −R(α_i|x) is equivalent to P(ω_i|x)

concepts.name: Ipotesi di lavoro: C classi con distribuzioni gaussiane multivariate
concepts.nameEn: Minimum-error-rate discriminant functions for C classes with multivariate Gaussian distributions

concepts.name: Pdf gaussiana multivariata condizionata alla classe
concepts.nameEn: Multivariate Gaussian class-conditional pdf p(x|ω_i) = N(m_i, Σ_i)

concepts.name: Discriminante logaritmico (criterio MAP)
concepts.nameEn: g_i(x) = ln p(x|ω_i) + ln P(ω_i)

concepts.name: Discriminante gaussiano generale a quattro termini
concepts.nameEn: General Gaussian discriminant function

concepts.name: Anatomia dei quattro termini del discriminante gaussiano
concepts.nameEn: Roles of the four terms: quadratic (Mahalanobis) term, constant, log-determinant, log-prior

concepts.name: Eliminazione della costante −(n/2) ln 2π
concepts.nameEn: Dropping −(n/2) ln 2π since it doesn't depend on the class

concepts.name: I tre casi: la forma delle gaussiane decide la partizione dello spazio
concepts.nameEn: Three cases: how the shape of Gaussian distributions affects the partitioning of the feature space

concepts.name: Caso 1: Σ_i = σ²I, covarianza sferica uguale per tutte le classi
concepts.nameEn: Case 1: Σ_i = σ²I (covariance matrix is a scalar multiple of the identity matrix)

concepts.name: Caso 1: il discriminante diventa una distanza euclidea corretta dal prior
concepts.nameEn: Case 1 intermediate form: g_i(x) = −‖x − m_i‖²/(2σ²) + ln P(ω_i)

concepts.name: Caso 1 con prior uguali: classificatore a minima distanza dalla media
concepts.nameEn: Case 1 with equal priors reduces to the minimum-distance (nearest-mean) classifier

concepts.name: Linearizzazione: il termine xᵗx è comune a tutte le classi
concepts.nameEn: Dropping the class-independent quadratic term xᵗx gives a linear function of x

concepts.name: Discriminante lineare del Caso 1: pesi e soglia
concepts.nameEn: Case 1 linear discriminant: g_i(x) = w_iᵗx + w_i0, w_i = m_i/σ², w_i0 = −m_iᵗm_i/(2σ²) + ln P(ω_i)

concepts.name: Pesi, soglia/bias e significato di 'discriminante lineare'
concepts.nameEn: Weights w_i and threshold/bias w_i0; linear discriminant

concepts.name: I confini di decisione sono le ipersuperfici g_i(x) = g_j(x)
concepts.nameEn: Decision boundaries are the hypersurfaces corresponding to g_i(x) = g_j(x)

concepts.name: Caso 1: il confine è l'iperpiano wᵗ(x − x_0) = 0 con w = m_i − m_j
concepts.nameEn: Case 1 boundary: hyperplane wᵗ(x − x0) = 0, w = m_i − m_j

concepts.name: Caso 1: il punto x_0 del confine
concepts.nameEn: Case 1 point x0 = ½(m_i + m_j) − σ²/‖m_i − m_j‖² ln[P(ω_i)/P(ω_j)] (m_i − m_j)

concepts.name: Caso 1: iperpiano ortogonale alla congiungente delle medie
concepts.nameEn: Hyperplane separating ℜi and ℜj passes through the point x0 and is orthogonal to the vector w

concepts.name: Prior uguali: x_0 è il punto medio, il confine è l'asse del segmento
concepts.nameEn: Equal priors: x0 is the midpoint; the boundary is the perpendicular bisector of the segment between the means

concepts.name: Prior diversi: il confine si sposta verso la classe meno frequente
concepts.nameEn: If one class is more frequent, the boundary shifts towards the less frequent class

concepts.name: Figura 1-D del Caso 1: la soglia si sposta con P(ω1) = .7
concepts.nameEn: Case 1: Examples with 1-D distributions (P(ω1) = .5 vs .7)

concepts.name: Figura 2-D del Caso 1: campane circolari e confine rettilineo
concepts.nameEn: Case 1: Examples with 2-D distributions (P(ω1) = .5 vs .8)

concepts.name: Figura 3-D del Caso 1: sfere e piano separatore
concepts.nameEn: Case 1: Examples with 3-D distributions (P(ω1) = .5 vs .8)

concepts.name: Caso 2: Σ_i = Σ, covarianza comune
concepts.nameEn: Case 2: Σ_i = Σ (the classes share a common covariance matrix)

concepts.name: Caso 2: la distanza di Mahalanobis
concepts.nameEn: Case 2 intermediate form: squared Mahalanobis distance (x − m_i)ᵗΣ⁻¹(x − m_i)

concepts.name: Caso 2: perché il discriminante è lineare
concepts.nameEn: Case 2 linearization: xᵗΣ⁻¹x is class-independent; symmetry of Σ⁻¹ merges the cross terms

concepts.name: Discriminante lineare del Caso 2
concepts.nameEn: Case 2 linear discriminant: w_i = Σ⁻¹m_i, w_i0 = −½ m_iᵗΣ⁻¹m_i + ln P(ω_i)

concepts.name: Caso 2: confine wᵗ(x − x_0) = 0 con w = Σ⁻¹(m_i − m_j)
concepts.nameEn: Case 2 decision boundary: wᵗ(x − x0) = 0 with w = Σ⁻¹(m_i − m_j)

concepts.name: Caso 2: il punto x_0
concepts.nameEn: Case 2 point x0 = ½(m_i + m_j) − ln[P(ω_i)/P(ω_j)](m_i − m_j) / [(m_i − m_j)ᵗΣ⁻¹(m_i − m_j)]

concepts.name: Caso 2: iperpiano non necessariamente ortogonale alla congiungente
concepts.nameEn: Hyperplane passes through x0 but is not necessarily orthogonal to the line between the means

concepts.name: Il Caso 1 è un caso particolare del Caso 2
concepts.nameEn: Case 1 is the special case Σ = σ²I of Case 2

concepts.name: I prior traslano il confine, non lo ruotano
concepts.nameEn: Priors translate the hyperplane along the line through the means (w does not depend on priors)

concepts.name: Figura 2-D del Caso 2: ellissi uguali e confine obliquo
concepts.nameEn: Case 2: Examples with 2-D distributions (P = .5/.5 vs P(ω2) = .9, P(ω1) = .1)

concepts.name: Figura 3-D del Caso 2: ellissoidi e piano inclinato
concepts.nameEn: Case 2: Examples with 3-D distributions (P = .5/.5 vs P(ω1) = .1, P(ω2) = .9)

concepts.name: Caso 3: Σ_i arbitraria, una covarianza per classe
concepts.nameEn: Case 3: Σ_i = arbitrary (each class has its unique covariance matrix)

concepts.name: Discriminante quadratico
concepts.nameEn: Quadratic discriminant: g_i(x) = xᵗW_ix + w_iᵗx + w_i0

concepts.name: Parametri del discriminante quadratico
concepts.nameEn: Case 3 parameters: W_i = −½Σ_i⁻¹, w_i = Σ_i⁻¹m_i, w_i0 = −½ m_iᵗΣ_i⁻¹m_i − ½ ln|Σ_i| + ln P(ω_i)

concepts.name: Confini iperquadrici
concepts.nameEn: Decision boundaries are hyperquadrics

concepts.name: Figura p35: coniche degeneri (rette parallele, rette incidenti)
concepts.nameEn: Case 3: Examples with 2-D distributions (degenerate conics)

concepts.name: Figura p36: parabola ed ellisse
concepts.nameEn: Case 3: Examples with 2-D distributions (parabola, ellipse)

concepts.name: Figura p37: iperbole e cerchio (stessa media, varianze diverse)
concepts.nameEn: Case 3: Examples with 2-D distributions (hyperbola, circle)

concepts.name: La classe più dispersa vince lontano in tutte le direzioni
concepts.nameEn: Far from the data, the class with the larger covariance wins (bounded regions for concentrated classes)

concepts.name: Figura p38: sei iperquadriche in 3-D
concepts.nameEn: Case 3: Examples with 3-D distributions (hyperquadric boundaries)

concepts.name: Figura p39: sella, paraboloide, iperboloide a due falde
concepts.nameEn: Case 3: Examples with 3-D distributions (saddle, paraboloid, two-sheet hyperboloid)

concepts.name: Quattro classi: regioni di decisione non connesse
concepts.nameEn: Case 3: Example with 3-D distributions — four classes, decision regions ℜ1…ℜ4 (ℜ4 not connected)

concepts.name: Sintesi: la complessità del confine cresce con la libertà della covarianza
concepts.nameEn: In summary, the complexity of decision boundaries escalates with the freedom of covariance matrices

concepts.name: Confronto tra i tre casi
concepts.nameEn: Comparison of Case 1, Case 2 and Case 3 (dropped terms, discriminant, boundary, parameters)

concepts.name: Esempio: dati del problema (Caso 2, tre feature)
concepts.nameEn: Discriminant Functions: Example — two classes, equal priors, shared covariance

concepts.name: Esempio: riconoscere il Caso 2 e togliere il prior
concepts.nameEn: Since the classes share a common covariance matrix, we can apply a linear discriminant function as derived in Case 2

concepts.name: Esempio: i due discriminanti
Esempio: confine f_12(x) = 8x1 − 8x2 − 8x3 + 4 = 0
concepts.nameEn: The decision boundary takes the form f12(x) = g1(x) − g2(x) = 8x1 − 8x2 − 8x3 + 4 = 0

concepts.name: Esempio: i dati stampati sono incoerenti con il risultato
concepts.nameEn: Inconsistency between the printed data (p41) and the results (p42); consistent reconstruction

concepts.name: Caso 3: i prior cambiano solo la costante della quadrica
concepts.nameEn: In Case 3 the priors enter only through w_i0 (they shift or resize the hyperquadric)

concepts.name: Con discriminanti lineari le regioni sono convesse e connesse
concepts.nameEn: Linear discriminants (linear machine) give convex, connected decision regions

concepts.name: Nell'esempio l'iperpiano è ortogonale alla congiungente (caso fortunato)
concepts.nameEn: In the example, m1 − m2 is an eigenvector of Σ, so the Case 2 hyperplane happens to be orthogonal to the line between the means

concepts.name: CART: un framework generale per costruire alberi
concepts.nameEn: Classification and Regression Trees (CART), general framework

concepts.name: Le questioni di progetto di CART
concepts.nameEn: Number of splits, test selection and node impurity, when to stop splitting, pruning, assignment of leaf node labels

concepts.name: Split
concepts.nameEn: Split

concepts.name: La radice divide tutto il training set, i nodi successivi sottoinsiemi propri
concepts.nameEn: The root node splits the full training set; each successive decision splits a proper subset of the data

concepts.name: Fattore di ramificazione: di solito split binari
concepts.nameEn: Branching factor (number of splits), binary splits

concepts.name: Ogni albero può essere modellato come albero binario
concepts.nameEn: Every tree can be modelled as a binary tree

concepts.name: La versione binaria dell'albero della frutta
concepts.nameEn: Binary version of the fruit tree (color = Green?, size = big?, ...)

concepts.name: Selezione del test (query) a ogni nodo
concepts.nameEn: Test selection: which property test or query should be performed at each node

concepts.name: Il test determina i confini di decisione: regioni a scalini e scatole
concepts.nameEn: Test selection defines the decision boundaries produced by the tree

concepts.name: Alberi monotetici
concepts.nameEn: Monothetic trees

concepts.name: Principio di semplicità
concepts.nameEn: Simplicity: we prefer decisions that lead to a simple, compact tree with few nodes

concepts.name: Addestramento locale, nodo per nodo
concepts.nameEn: Sequence of localized training steps at each node

concepts.name: Il test T al nodo N deve rendere i discendenti il più puri possibile
concepts.nameEn: Property test T at each node N that makes the data reaching the immediate descendent nodes as pure as possible

concepts.name: Misurare l'impurità invece della purezza; molte misure con lo stesso comportamento
concepts.nameEn: It is more convenient to define the impurity, rather than the purity of a node; measures of impurity

concepts.name: Proprietà richieste a i(N): zero se puro, grande se classi equamente rappresentate
concepts.nameEn: i(N) = 0 if all patterns bear the same category label, large if the categories are equally represented

concepts.name: P(ω_j): frazione dei pattern del nodo N che appartengono a ω_j
concepts.nameEn: Fraction of patterns at node N belonging to ω_j

concepts.name: Impurità entropica
concepts.nameEn: Entropy impurity

concepts.name: Impurità di varianza (due classi)
concepts.nameEn: Variance impurity

concepts.name: Impurità di Gini
concepts.nameEn: Gini impurity

concepts.name: Impurità di misclassificazione
concepts.nameEn: Misclassification impurity

concepts.name: Confronto delle impurità: il grafico i(P) con due classi
concepts.nameEn: i(P) curves: entropy, Gini/variance, misclassification

concepts.name: La domanda chiave: quale valore s per il test T al nodo N?
concepts.nameEn: Given a partial tree down to node N, what value s should we choose for the property test T?

concepts.name: Euristica: il test che riduce di più l'impurità
concepts.nameEn: Choose the test that decreases the impurity as much as possible

concepts.name: Caduta di impurità Δi(N)
concepts.nameEn: Drop in impurity

concepts.name: Il test migliore massimizza Δi
concepts.nameEn: The best test value s is the choice for T that maximizes Δi(T)

concepts.name: Alberi a più rami: versioni adattate del drop
concepts.nameEn: For multibranch trees, suitable drop versions have to be used

concepts.name: Ottimizzazione locale e greedy: nessuna garanzia di ottimo globale
concepts.nameEn: The optimization is local; no guarantee that successive locally greedy optimal decisions lead to the global optimum

concepts.name: Criterio twoing: super-categorie C1 e C2
concepts.nameEn: Twoing criterion, candidate super-categories C1 and C2

concepts.name: Procedura twoing: Δi(s;C1), ŝ(C1) e Ĉ1
concepts.nameEn: Twoing: change in impurity Δi(s;C1), best split ŝ(C1), best super-category Ĉ1

concepts.name: Crescita completa: overfitting
concepts.nameEn: Growing the tree fully: the data has typically been overfit

concepts.name: Fermarsi troppo presto: errore di training alto, serve un compromesso
concepts.nameEn: If splitting is stopped too early, the error on the training data is not sufficiently low

concepts.name: Criterio di stop 1: cross-validation
concepts.nameEn: Cross-validation

concepts.name: Criterio di stop 2: soglia sulla riduzione di impurità
concepts.nameEn: Impurity reduction threshold (minimum impurity reduction threshold)

concepts.name: Criterio di stop 3: compromesso complessità-accuratezza
concepts.nameEn: Complexity-accuracy tradeoff criterion

concepts.name: Criterio di stop 4: test d'ipotesi
concepts.nameEn: Hypothesis testing

concepts.name: Stopped splitting = pre-pruning: il rischio di fermarsi troppo presto
concepts.nameEn: Stopped splitting (called also pre-pruning)

concepts.name: Pruning (post-pruning): crescere completamente, poi valutare le coppie di foglie vicine
concepts.nameEn: Pruning: the tree is grown fully, then all pairs of neighboring leaf nodes are considered for elimination

concepts.name: Criterio di eliminazione: piccolo aumento di impurità, l'antenato diventa foglia
concepts.nameEn: Any pair whose elimination yields a satisfactory (small) increase in impurity is eliminated

concepts.name: Fondere è l'inverso di dividere
concepts.nameEn: Merging or joining of the two leaf nodes is the inverse of splitting

concepts.name: Dopo il pruning: foglie su molti livelli, albero sbilanciato
concepts.nameEn: Leaf nodes lie in a wide range of levels and the tree is unbalanced

concepts.name: Beneficio del post-pruning: usa tutta l'informazione del training set
concepts.nameEn: The main benefit of pruning (called also post-pruning) is it directly uses all information in the training set

concepts.name: Costo del post-pruning: più calcolo, proibitivo con grandi training set
concepts.nameEn: Greater computational expense than stopped splitting; for large training sets the expense can be prohibitive

concepts.name: Assegnazione delle etichette: il passo più semplice; foglia pura, etichetta ovvia
concepts.nameEn: Assigning category labels to the leaf nodes is the simplest step in tree construction

concepts.name: Un'impurità estremamente piccola non è necessariamente desiderabile
concepts.nameEn: An extremely small impurity is not necessarily desirable, since it may be an indication that the tree is overfitting

concepts.name: Foglie impure: etichetta della classe di maggioranza
concepts.nameEn: Each leaf should be labeled by the category that has most points represented

concepts.name: Costo di addestramento degli alberi multivariati: parte lento, poi accelera
concepts.nameEn: Training multivariate decision trees starts off slowly, then accelerates significantly

concepts.name: Tutti i metodi ad albero condividono gli stessi concetti; flessibilità di progetto
concepts.nameEn: Virtually all tree-based classification techniques can incorporate the fundamental concepts described previously

concepts.name: La maggior parte degli algoritmi usa l'impurità entropica
concepts.nameEn: Most tree-growing algorithms use an entropy impurity

concepts.nameEn: Classification and Regression Trees: each branch is a test on a feature that guides data classification or regression

concepts.nameEn: The goal in modeling is to choose a model from the hypothesis space, which is closest (with respect to some error measure) to the underlying function in the target space

concepts.name: Spazio target e spazio delle ipotesi
concepts.nameEn: Target space, Hypothesis space

concepts.name: Le tre funzioni del diagramma: f_true(x), f(x,α), f(x,α̂)
concepts.nameEn: f_true(x), f(x,α), f(x,α̂)

concepts.name: Errore di approssimazione
concepts.nameEn: Approximation error

concepts.name: Ridurre l'errore di approssimazione con un modello più flessibile, e il suo prezzo
concepts.nameEn: To reduce this error, one can choose a more flexible model, effectively expanding the hypothesis space. However, increasing model complexity risks overfitting

concepts.name: Errore di stima
concepts.nameEn: Estimation error

concepts.name: Errore di generalizzazione
concepts.nameEn: Generalization error

concepts.name: Overfitting
concepts.nameEn: Overfitting

concepts.name: Modelli semplici contro modelli complessi: cercare il modello bilanciato
concepts.nameEn: Simple models are generally less prone to high estimation error ... Complex models ... may have low training error but may not generalize well to new data, suffering from high estimation error. The goal is to find a balanced model

concepts.name: La macchina che impara la corrispondenza x_i → y_i da una distribuzione ignota P(x,y)
concepts.nameEn: a machine whose task is to learn the mapping x_i→y_i, assuming that there exists some unknown probability distribution P(x,y) from which (training) data are drawn

concepts.name: Ipotesi i.i.d. sui dati
concepts.nameEn: The data are assumed independently drawn and identically distributed (i.i.d.)

concepts.name: La macchina come famiglia di funzioni f(x,α) indicizzate dai parametri regolabili α
concepts.nameEn: The machine is actually defined by a set of possible mappings x→f(x,α), where the functions f(x,α) themselves are labeled by the adjustable parameters α

concepts.name: Macchina deterministica
concepts.nameEn: The machine is assumed to be deterministic, i.e., for a given input x, and choice of α, it will always give the same output f(x,α)

concepts.name: Macchina addestrata
concepts.nameEn: A particular choice of α generates what we will call a trained machine

concepts.name: Rischio atteso: valore atteso dell'errore di generalizzazione
concepts.nameEn: The expectation of the generalization error for a trained machine

concepts.name: R(α) si chiama rischio atteso, o semplicemente rischio
concepts.nameEn: The quantity R(α) is called the expected risk, or just the risk

concepts.name: Gli elementi della formula del rischio: R(α), L(y,f(x,α)), p(x,y), X×Y
concepts.nameEn: R(α) is the expected risk associated with model parameters α; L(y,f(x,α)) is the loss function, which quantifies the error between the predicted f(x,α) and true y; p(x,y) is the joint probability distribution of x and y

concepts.name: Funzione di loss
concepts.nameEn: Loss function

concepts.name: La loss d'esempio della slide: L = ½|y − f(x,α)|
concepts.nameEn: Loss function, e.g., L(y,f(x,α)) = 1/2 |y − f(x,α)|

concepts.name: Errore quadratico per la regressione
concepts.nameEn: squared error for regression

concepts.name: Loss e misure per la regressione chieste all'orale: MSE, RMSE, errore assoluto, coefficiente di correlazione
concepts.nameEn: Loss function (correlation coefficient - MSE - RMSE - absolute error)

concepts.name: R(α) è l'errore medio vero, ma senza p(x,y) non si calcola
concepts.nameEn: This is a nice way of writing the true mean error, but unless we have an estimate of what p(x,y) is, it is not very useful

concepts.name: Rischio empirico R_emp(α)
concepts.nameEn: Empirical risk R_emp(α) is defined to be the measured average loss (e.g., mean error rate) on the training set (for a fixed, finite number of observations)

concepts.name: Con la loss 0-1 il rischio empirico è il tasso d'errore
concepts.nameEn: mean error rate

concepts.name: L'approssimazione R_emp ≈ R vale solo se N è molto grande
concepts.nameEn: Such an approximation of the generalization error is valid only if N>>

concepts.name: Al crescere di N il rischio empirico converge al rischio vero
concepts.nameEn: As the number of training samples N increases, the empirical risk R_emp(α) converges to the true risk R(α)

concepts.name: Minimizzazione del rischio empirico (ERM)
concepts.nameEn: empirical risk minimization

concepts.name: In pratica N non è grande: serve un'approssimazione per stimare l'accuratezza
concepts.nameEn: As in general N<<, we have but the choice to resort to some approximation to estimate the accuracy of a machine

concepts.name: L'errore sul training set è una stima ottimista dell'errore di generalizzazione
concepts.nameEn: Complex models may have low training error but may not generalize well to new data

concepts.name: Scopo 1 della valutazione: regolare gli iperparametri
concepts.nameEn: Tune hyperparameters

concepts.name: Scopo 2: valutare l'efficacia di una macchina addestrata
concepts.nameEn: Evaluate effectiveness of a trained machine

concepts.name: Scopo 3: confronto statistico tra macchine diverse
concepts.nameEn: Make statistical comparison between different machines

concepts.name: Tassonomia delle procedure di valutazione (slide 67)
concepts.nameEn: Evaluation Procedures: Exhaustive Cross-Validation, Non-Exhaustive Cross-Validation, Nested Cross-Validation

concepts.name: Le procedure si classificano per quanto esaustivamente usano i dati
concepts.nameEn: Evaluation procedures provide methods to assess a model's performance and generalization ability. These techniques are broadly categorized based on how exhaustively they use the data during validation

concepts.name: Cross-validation esaustiva
concepts.nameEn: Exhaustive Cross-Validation: In exhaustive methods, the model is evaluated on every possible train-test split of the dataset

concepts.name: Leave-One-Out (LOO-CV)
concepts.nameEn: Leave-One-Out Cross-Validation (LOO-CV)

concepts.name: Cross-validation non esaustiva
concepts.nameEn: Non-Exhaustive Cross-Validation: Non-exhaustive methods only consider a subset of possible train-test splits, making them computationally more efficient

concepts.name: Hold-Out
concepts.nameEn: Hold-Out: The data is randomly split into two distinct sets: a training set and a test set

concepts.name: k-Fold Cross-Validation
concepts.nameEn: k-Fold Cross-Validation

concepts.name: Monte Carlo Cross-Validation
concepts.nameEn: Monte Carlo Cross-Validation

concepts.name: Nested Cross-Validation
concepts.nameEn: Nested Cross-Validation: used primarily for hyperparameter tuning, providing an unbiased performance estimate for models that involve a search over multiple hyperparameter settings

concepts.name: k×I-Fold Cross-Validation
concepts.nameEn: k × I-Fold Cross-Validation

concepts.name: Il leave-one-out è il k-fold con k = N
concepts.nameEn: Leave-One-Out vs k-Fold

concepts.name: Confronto tra le procedure: costo computazionale e variabilità della stima
concepts.nameEn: computationally intensive / computationally more efficient / high variance / reliable estimate / robust error estimate

concepts.name: A cosa servono in definitiva le procedure di valutazione
concepts.nameEn: These evaluation methods are essential tools for assessing and comparing models, helping to select models with optimal performance on unseen data

concepts.name: Con la loss 0-1 il rischio atteso è la probabilità d'errore, minimizzata dal classificatore MAP
concepts.nameEn: expected risk under 0-1 loss = probability of error (Bayes classifier)

concepts.name: Scomposizione dell'errore in termini di rischio: stima + approssimazione
concepts.nameEn: generalization error = estimation error + approximation error

concepts.name: Perché il MAP potrebbe non essere il migliore: l'errore di approssimazione (e di stima)
concepts.nameEn: Why MAP could not be the best one? (Linked to approximation error)

concepts.name: Cosa fare se l'accuratezza è bassa: diagnosticare approssimazione o stima
concepts.nameEn: What can we do when the model has low accuracy?

concepts.name: Criterio twoing: miglior split e miglior supercategoria
concepts.nameEn: Twoing criterion: Δi(s;C1), ŝ(C1), Ĉ1

concepts.name: Quando fermare la crescita: overfitting contro arresto prematuro
concepts.nameEn: Fully growing a tree ... often leads to overfitting ... Conversely, if splitting is stopped too early, then the error on the training data is not sufficiently low

concepts.name: Criteri di arresto comuni: cross-validation, soglia di riduzione dell'impurità, compromesso complessità-accuratezza, test d'ipotesi
concepts.nameEn: Cross-Validation; Minimum Impurity Reduction Threshold; Complexity-Accuracy Tradeoff; Hypothesis Testing

concepts.name: Stopped splitting (pre-pruning) e il rischio di fermarsi troppo presto
concepts.nameEn: In stopped splitting (called also pre-pruning), node N might be declared a leaf, cutting off the possibility of beneficial splits in subsequent nodes

concepts.name: Pruning (post-pruning): fondere coppie di foglie sorelle
concepts.nameEn: The alternative is pruning (post-pruning), which refines a fully grown tree by removing nodes that minimally improve accuracy

concepts.name: Pruning: più calcolo, ma albero più robusto che generalizza meglio
concepts.nameEn: Pruning uses the entire training dataset, so it requires more computation than stopping splitting early (pre-pruning). However, it often produces a more robust tree with better generalization

concepts.name: Assegnazione dell'etichetta alle foglie: classe pura o maggioranza
concepts.nameEn: Leaf Node Label Assignment

concepts.name: Esempio di instabilità del CART: un punto spostato da x_2 = .36 a .32
concepts.nameEn: CART models can be unstable due to their sensitivity to small changes in the data

concepts.name: Causa dell'instabilità: decisioni localmente ottime e suscettibilità all'overfitting
concepts.nameEn: This instability arises because decision tree training relies on locally optimal decisions at each node, which does not guarantee a globally optimal solution

concepts.name: Nei CART standard i confini sono paralleli agli assi
concepts.nameEn: In standard CART trees, decision boundaries are aligned with the feature axes, as each node tests a single feature

concepts.name: Alberi multivariati (politetici)
concepts.nameEn: multivariate or polythetic decision trees

concepts.name: Split non paralleli agli assi con un classificatore lineare
concepts.nameEn: The simplest multivariate approach involves allowing splits that are not parallel to the feature axes, such as those achieved through a linear classifier trained with gradient descent on a classification or sum-squared-error criterion

concepts.name: Figura: albero univariato contro albero multivariato sugli stessi dati
concepts.nameEn: univariate (axis-parallel) tree vs multivariate tree

concepts.name: Costo di addestramento degli alberi multivariati: lento all'inizio, poi accelera
concepts.nameEn: Training multivariate decision trees starts off slowly ... as the tree grows and each node has fewer samples to split, the training process accelerates significantly

concepts.name: Flessibilità di progetto degli alberi
concepts.nameEn: Tree-based classification methods offer flexibility in design: branching factor, impurity index, stopping rules, pruning methods, and how to handle missing attributes

concepts.name: ID3
concepts.nameEn: ID3: well-suited for nominal data ... grow trees using the concept of information gain to determine splits

concepts.name: C4.5
concepts.nameEn: C4.5: builds on ID3 by accommodating datasets with missing values and using gain ratio for split selection, which helps address bias in favor of features with more levels

concepts.name: Random forest: dall'instabilità degli alberi a un ensemble stabile
concepts.nameEn: Instability in decision trees ... has led to innovations like Random Forests

concepts.name: Due impostazioni per stimare i parametri: ML e bayesiana
concepts.nameEn: Settings: Maximum Likelihood Estimation vs Bayesian Estimation

concepts.name: Dataset di training i.i.d. per la classe target
concepts.nameEn: A training dataset D = {x_1, …, x_n} of i.i.d. (independent and identically distributed) examples for the target class y is available

concepts.name: Parametri fissi ma ignoti (visione ML)
concepts.nameEn: The parameter vector θ is assumed to have a fixed but unknown value

concepts.name: Stima ML: massimizzare la verosimiglianza
concepts.nameEn: The goal is to estimate θ by maximizing its likelihood with respect to the training data

concepts.name: Fattorizzazione della verosimiglianza per esempi i.i.d.
concepts.nameEn: the joint probability p(D|θ) decomposes into a product since the examples are i.i.d., implying independence given the distribution

concepts.name: Log-verosimiglianza
concepts.nameEn: maximize the logarithm of the likelihood rather than the likelihood itself

concepts.name: Perché il logaritmo: somma al posto del prodotto, monotonia preservata
concepts.nameEn: the logarithm simplifies the product into a summation, which is computationally and mathematically more manageable while preserving monotonicity

concepts.name: Condizione necessaria: gradiente nullo della log-verosimiglianza
concepts.nameEn: Necessary conditions for the maximum θ* can be derived by setting the gradient of the log-likelihood with respect to θ to zero

concepts.name: Gradiente nullo: massimi locali o globali secondo la forma della distribuzione
concepts.nameEn: Points where the gradient is zero may correspond to local or global maxima, depending on the form of the probability distribution

concepts.name: Condizioni del secondo ordine: la matrice Hessiana
concepts.nameEn: Additional second-order conditions (e.g., checking the Hessian matrix) may be required to determine whether these points are maxima, minima or saddle points

concepts.name: Setting bayesiano: parametri come variabili aleatorie con prior noto
concepts.nameEn: Bayesian estimation assumes that the parameters θ_i are random variables with a known prior distribution p(θ)

concepts.name: Predizione bayesiana: integrare su tutti i valori dei parametri
concepts.nameEn: Predictions for new examples are made by integrating over all possible values of the parameters

concepts.name: Semplificazione: una classe alla volta
concepts.nameEn: if the probability of x given a class y_i is independent of other classes y_j, the expression can often be simplified

concepts.name: La densità predittiva come media pesata dalla posterior
concepts.nameEn: The conditional probability p(x|D) can be rewritten as ∫ p(x|θ) p(θ|D) dθ

concepts.name: p(x|θ) si calcola direttamente: forma e parametri noti
concepts.nameEn: p(x|θ) can often be directly computed, since the form and parameters of the distribution are known (e.g., Gaussian)

concepts.name: Posterior dei parametri con il teorema di Bayes
concepts.nameEn: The posterior distribution p(θ|D) (the parameter posterior density given the training set)

concepts.name: Verosimiglianza, prior ed evidenza
concepts.nameEn: p(D|θ): Likelihood of the data given the parameters; p(θ): Prior distribution of the parameters; p(D): Marginal likelihood or evidence

concepts.name: L'evidenza p(D) non influenza la decisione
concepts.nameEn: p(D) is a constant independent of θ, so it does not influence the final Bayesian decision

concepts.name: Calcolo esplicito dell'evidenza
concepts.nameEn: if the full posterior distribution or exact probability values are required (not only decision), p(D) can be computed explicitly

concepts.name: Statistica
concepts.nameEn: Statistic: Any function computed on a set of samples D

concepts.name: Statistica sufficiente
concepts.nameEn: Sufficient Statistic: A statistic s = φ(D) is sufficient for a parameters θ if P(D|s, θ) = P(D|s)

concepts.name: Con θ aleatorio, la posterior dipende solo dalla statistica sufficiente
concepts.nameEn: If θ is treated as a random variable, the sufficient statistic contains all the information that D provides for estimating θ

concepts.name: Una statistica sufficiente è tutta l'informazione che serve da D
concepts.nameEn: So, a sufficient statistic is all the information you need from D to estimate the parameter θ

concepts.name: Uso: compressione dei dati
concepts.nameEn: Compression of Data: A sufficient statistic allows compressing a large dataset D into fewer values while preserving the information necessary for estimating θ

concepts.name: Esempio: media e covarianza campionarie sono sufficienti per la gaussiana
concepts.nameEn: The sample mean and sample covariance are sufficient statistics for estimating the true mean and covariance of a Gaussian (normal) distribution

concepts.name: La statistica sufficiente dipende dalla forma della distribuzione
concepts.nameEn: In general, the choice of a sufficient statistic depends on the specific form of the probability distribution associated with θ

concepts.name: Prior coniugato
concepts.nameEn: A conjugate prior refers to a prior distribution p(θ) that, when combined with a likelihood function p(x|θ), yields a posterior distribution p(θ|x) of the same family as the prior

concepts.name: Definizione formale di coniugatezza
concepts.nameEn: Formally, if: p(θ) and p(x|θ) ⇒ p(θ|x) which is in the same family as p(θ), then p(θ) is a conjugate prior for p(x|θ)

concepts.name: Esempio: verosimiglianza gaussiana con media ignota
concepts.nameEn: Example: Gaussian Likelihood with Gaussian Prior. Suppose the likelihood function is Gaussian: x ∼ N(μ, σ²), where μ is the unknown mean

concepts.name: Prior gaussiano sulla media: la posterior resta gaussiana
concepts.nameEn: If the prior on μ is also Gaussian, e.g., μ ∼ N(μ0, σ0²), the posterior p(μ|x) will remain Gaussian. In this case, the Gaussian prior is conjugate to the Gaussian likelihood

concepts.name: Parametri della posterior gaussiana (completamento dal Cap. 2)
concepts.nameEn: Posterior mean and variance of μ for Gaussian likelihood with Gaussian prior

concepts.name: Utilità dei coniugati: forma funzionale conservata, soluzioni analitiche
concepts.nameEn: Simplifies Computation: The posterior distribution retains the same functional form as the prior, making analytical solutions possible

concepts.name: Niente integrali complessi per l'inferenza
concepts.nameEn: You don't need to compute complex integrals for inference, which simplifies Bayesian updates

concepts.name: Coerenza tra aggiornamenti successivi
concepts.nameEn: Consistency Across Updates: Repeated updates using new data x will still yield posteriors of the same form, allowing for iterative Bayesian updates

concepts.name: Intuizione: prior, verosimiglianza e posterior sullo stesso θ
concepts.nameEn: Key Intuition: The relationship between the prior, likelihood, and posterior operates on the same parameter θ

concepts.name: Intuizione: la «forma» del prior resta, cambiano i parametri
concepts.nameEn: A conjugate prior ensures that the "shape" of the prior distribution remains consistent, even as new data updates the parameters

concepts.nameEn: Structure: wᵀx, w₀ (bias as a weight on a constant input of 1), sign(·) threshold activation

concepts.nameEn: The number of required neurons grows exponentially with the number of input variables, making the network shallow but wide

concepts.name: Limiti delle architetture poco profonde
concepts.nameEn: Single perceptrons or shallow architectures cannot separate complex datasets; two-layer networks often require an exponential number of perceptrons

concepts.name: Reti neurali profonde: rappresentazioni gerarchiche

concepts.name: Soluzione in forma chiusa: si annulla il gradiente

concepts.name: La MSE trova la soluzione esatta se esiste, altrimenti la migliore approssimazione
concepts.nameEn: So if there is an exact solution, MSE finds it, otherwise it will provide an approximation which minimizes the squared error

concepts.name: Variabili latenti z_ij

concepts.name: Densità gaussiana univariata
concepts.nameEn: Univariate Gaussian with variance σ^2: p(x_i | μ_j)

concepts.name: E-step in forma esplicita (la costante si semplifica)
concepts.nameEn: Thus, E[z_ij] as a ratio of exponentials (normalization constant cancels)

concepts.name: M-step: media pesata
concepts.nameEn: M-Step: Parameter Update, weighted mean of each cluster

concepts.nameEn: Points with higher probability of belonging to a Gaussian contribute more to the updated mean

concepts.nameEn: Goal: estimate parameters that maximize the expected log-likelihood of the data (expectation over unobserved data)

concepts.name: Il problema: Z dipende da X e da h

concepts.name: Verosimiglianza di un esempio completo

concepts.nameEn: Run multiple episodes of interaction with the environment (e.g., playing many games of chess)

concepts.name: Adaptive Dynamic Programming (ADP): l'idea
concepts.nameEn: Adaptive Dynamic Programming (ADP)

concepts.name: Algoritmo ADP completo (pagg. 93-94)
concepts.nameEn: ADP Algorithm (Loop: Initialize state s; Repeat until reaching a terminal state)

concepts.name: Stima della ricompensa: R(s) = r
concepts.nameEn: Observe reward r and update reward estimate: R(s) = r

concepts.name: Aggiornamento dei conteggi stato-azione
concepts.nameEn: Update counts (tracking visits to state-action pairs)

concepts.name: Stima delle probabilità di transizione e rinormalizzazione
concepts.nameEn: Update estimated transition probabilities (since the denominator changes, we must renormalize the entire probability distribution)

concepts.name: Passo di policy evaluation sul modello stimato
concepts.nameEn: Update utility estimates by solving the system of equations using the current estimates of p and R: U ← PolicyEvaluation(π, U, p, R, γ)

concepts.name: L'ADP usa la stima a massima verosimiglianza
concepts.nameEn: Uses maximum likelihood estimation to update transition probabilities

concepts.name: Dopo il modello, policy evaluation standard
concepts.nameEn: After updating the transition model, it runs standard policy evaluation, solving a system of equations for utility estimates

concepts.name: ADP computazionalmente costoso
concepts.nameEn: Computationally expensive because each step requires solving these equations

concepts.name: ADP converge alle utilità vere nel lungo periodo
concepts.nameEn: Converges to true utilities in the long run as more data is collected

concepts.name: TD learning: aggiornare localmente invece di risolvere sistemi
concepts.nameEn: Temporal-Difference (TD) Policy Evaluation: updating utilities incrementally based on observed transitions

concepts.name: Ipotesi locale del TD: U(s) = R(s) + γU(s')
concepts.nameEn: Assumption that the utility of a state s should be U(s) = R(s) + γU(s'), where s' is the next observed state

concepts.name: Regola di aggiornamento TD
concepts.nameEn: TD Update Rule

concepts.name: Learning rate α (che può decrescere nel tempo)
concepts.nameEn: α is a learning rate (which can decrease over time)

concepts.name: Intuizione: il bersaglio sarebbe l'utilità vera se s' fosse sempre il successore
concepts.nameEn: If s' were always the successor of s, then the true utility of s would be exactly R(s) + γU(s')

concepts.name: Intuizione: la regola avvicina U(s) al bersaglio
concepts.nameEn: The update rule adjusts U(s) to move closer to this estimate

concepts.name: La differenza temporale come termine di correzione dell'errore
concepts.nameEn: The difference R(s) + γU(s') − U(s) acts as an error correction term

concepts.name: Intuizione: con più transizioni U(s) converge al valore vero
concepts.nameEn: Over time, as we see more transitions, U(s) gradually converges to its true value

concepts.name: Algoritmo TD (policy evaluation)
concepts.nameEn: TD Algorithm (Loop: Initialize state s; Repeat until reaching a terminal state)

concepts.name: Il TD non richiede un modello di transizione
concepts.nameEn: Does not require a transition model p(s'|s, a)

concepts.name: Aggiornamenti incrementali senza sistemi di equazioni
concepts.nameEn: Updates utilities incrementally, avoiding the need to solve a full system of equations

concepts.name: Ogni passo TD è economico rispetto all'ADP
concepts.nameEn: Each step is computationally cheap compared to ADP

concepts.name: Il TD converge più lentamente ma è più pratico
concepts.nameEn: Takes longer to converge but is more practical for large or unknown environments

concepts.name: Il TD come approssimazione efficiente dell'ADP
concepts.nameEn: Can be viewed as an efficient approximation of ADP

concepts.name: Quando il TD è particolarmente utile
concepts.nameEn: TD Learning is particularly useful when: the environment is too large to model explicitly; partial observability; online learning is required

concepts.name: Sintesi ADP contro TD: accuratezza in cambio di efficienza
concepts.nameEn: Key Takeaways: ADP builds a full transition model; TD updates incrementally without a model; TD trades off accuracy for efficiency

concepts.name: Policy learning: una politica data può essere subottima
concepts.nameEn: Policy Learning: the agent should simultaneously learn both the environment and the optimal policy

concepts.name: Le due componenti del policy learning
concepts.nameEn: Policy learning involves: learning the environment; learning the optimal policy for that environment

concepts.name: Agente greedy: ADP con il calcolo della politica ottima
concepts.nameEn: Replace policy evaluation in ADP with optimal policy computation based on the current knowledge of the environment (greedy agent)

concepts.name: Problema 1: complessità computazionale
concepts.nameEn: Computational Complexity: solving for the optimal policy at each step is expensive

concepts.name: Problema 2: esplorazione limitata, politica che si adatta troppo all'ambiente noto
concepts.nameEn: Limited Exploration: a suboptimal policy that overfits the initially known environment

concepts.name: Esempio: politica subottima appresa (la strada bassa)
concepts.nameEn: An example of suboptimal learned policy: the lower route (2,1) → (3,1) → (3,2) → (3,3)

concepts.name: La strada ottima non scoperta: (1,2) → (1,3) → (2,3)
concepts.nameEn: It fails to explore and learn the utilities of other states; it does not discover the optimal route (1,2) → (1,3) → (2,3)

concepts.name: Sfruttamento (exploitation)
concepts.nameEn: Exploitation: following the best-known actions based on current knowledge

concepts.name: Esplorazione (exploration)
concepts.nameEn: Exploration: trying new actions to discover better, unknown alternatives

concepts.name: L'agente puramente greedy solo sfrutta: serve un equilibrio
concepts.nameEn: A purely greedy agent only exploits and fails to explore, leading to suboptimal policies. A good balance is required

concepts.name: Strategia ε-greedy
concepts.nameEn: ϵ-greedy strategy

concepts.name: Inizializzazione ottimistica
concepts.nameEn: Optimistic Initialization: assign higher utility estimates to (relatively) unexplored state-action pairs

concepts.name: Funzione di esplorazione f e utilità ottimistica U+
concepts.nameEn: Define an exploration function f that balances exploration and exploitation

concepts.name: Le strategie impediscono di fissarsi troppo presto
concepts.nameEn: These strategies prevent the agent from settling too quickly on a suboptimal policy due to lack of exploration

concepts.name: Funzione Q: utilità delle azioni
concepts.nameEn: Action utilities Q(s, a), also called the Q-function: expected return for taking action a in state s

concepts.name: Q incorpora transizioni e utilità: niente modello
concepts.nameEn: Q(s, a) already incorporates both the transition probabilities and utilities; no need to explicitly estimate the transition model

concepts.name: Politica ottima dalla Q: argmax
concepts.nameEn: The optimal policy is then simply π*(s) = argmax_{a∈A} Q(s, a)

concepts.name: SARSA: TD on-policy
concepts.nameEn: SARSA (State-Action-Reward-State-Action) is an on-policy TD learning algorithm

concepts.name: Algoritmo SARSA
concepts.nameEn: SARSA Algorithm (Loop: Initialize s; Repeat ...; Until s is terminal)

concepts.name: Regola di aggiornamento SARSA
concepts.nameEn: SARSA update: Q(s, a) ← Q(s, a) + α(r + γQ(s', a') − Q(s, a))

concepts.name: π^ε: politica ε-greedy basata su Q
concepts.nameEn: π^ϵ is an ϵ-greedy policy that ensures exploration based on Q

concepts.name: Proprietà di SARSA: on-policy e politica stabile
concepts.nameEn: Key Properties: On-policy (uses the policy's own actions for updates); learns a stable policy over time

concepts.name: Q-learning: TD off-policy
concepts.nameEn: Q-learning is an off-policy method: it updates Q(s, a) based on the greedy optimal action, rather than the action taken by the current policy

concepts.name: Algoritmo Q-learning
concepts.nameEn: Q-learning Algorithm (Loop: Initialize s; Repeat ...; Until s is terminal)

concepts.name: Regola di aggiornamento Q-learning
concepts.nameEn: Q-learning update: Q(s, a) ← Q(s, a) + α(r + γ max_{a'∈A} Q(s', a') − Q(s, a))

concepts.name: Proprietà di Q-learning: off-policy e più flessibile
concepts.nameEn: Key Properties: Off-policy (uses the greedy action for learning, even if the policy is exploratory); More flexible (can learn from any set of experience, e.g., replay data)

concepts.name: SARSA vs Q-learning: SARSA segue l'azione effettiva ed è sensibile all'esplorazione
concepts.nameEn: SARSA (On-Policy TD Learning): updates Q(s, a) using actions selected by the current policy (including exploration steps); sensitive to the exploration strategy used

concepts.name: Q-learning indipendente dalla politica di comportamento
concepts.nameEn: Q-Learning (Off-Policy TD Learning): updates Q(s, a) using the greedy action regardless of the policy being followed; learns an optimal policy even from data generated by a different policy

concepts.name: Differenza 1: gli off-policy imparano da dati storici
concepts.nameEn: Off-policy methods (Q-learning) are more flexible: they can learn from historical data or traces from an unknown policy

concepts.name: Differenza 2: gli on-policy convergono più dolcemente
concepts.nameEn: On-policy methods (SARSA) tend to converge more smoothly and are often preferred in environments with stochastic transitions or continuous state spaces, where function approximation techniques like neural networks are used

concepts.name: Differenza 3: Q-learning ottimo nei casi deterministici, in difficoltà in quelli molto dinamici
concepts.nameEn: Q-learning is better suited for maximizing rewards in deterministic settings but may struggle in highly dynamic environments where a balance between exploration and exploitation is crucial

concepts.name: Quale usare: SARSA è più sicuro negli ambienti ad alto rischio
concepts.nameEn: SARSA is safer in high-risk environments (e.g., robotics, real-world decision-making) because it learns under the same policy used for acting

concepts.name: Quale usare: Q-learning è più efficiente nei campioni (benchmark e giochi)
concepts.nameEn: Q-learning is more sample-efficient and is widely used in reinforcement learning benchmarks and games, where maximizing long-term rewards is the main goal

concepts.name: In pratica si usano entrambi
concepts.nameEn: In practice, both methods are applied, and their effectiveness depends on the specific problem and environment dynamics

concepts.name: Rappresentazione tabellare e i suoi limiti
concepts.nameEn: Scaling to Large State Spaces: tabular representation of utility functions works well for small, discrete state spaces but becomes infeasible for large or continuous state spaces

concepts.name: Esempio: il backgammon ha circa 10^20 stati
concepts.nameEn: Backgammon has approximately 10^20 states, making a tabular representation impractical

concepts.name: Approssimazione di funzione: una funzione parametrica invece della tabella
concepts.nameEn: Function approximation: U(s) or Q(s, a) is represented as a parametric function instead of a table

concepts.name: Stati come vettori di feature
concepts.nameEn: Represent states as feature vectors (e.g., (x, y) coordinates in a maze)

concepts.name: Funzione parametrizzata che generalizza a stati mai visti
concepts.nameEn: Learn a parameterized function U_θ(s) or Q_θ(s, a) that can generalize to unseen states

concepts.name: Metodi di approssimazione: funzioni lineari, reti neurali
concepts.nameEn: Estimate state/action utilities using function approximation methods (e.g., linear functions, neural networks)

concepts.name: Figura: approssimazione lineare dell'utilità di stato (posizione del Go)
concepts.nameEn: An example of state utility function approximation: state s → feature vector φ_s × parameter vector θ = estimated value

concepts.name: Figura: Q-learning tabellare contro Deep Q-learning
concepts.nameEn: An example of action utility function approximation: Q Learning (Q Table) vs Deep Q Learning

concepts.name: Apprendere i parametri θ con ottimizzazione basata sul gradiente
concepts.nameEn: We need to learn the parameters θ using gradient-based optimization

concepts.name: Errore TD per l'utilità di stato approssimata
concepts.nameEn: TD Learning: State Utility Approximation. The TD error measures how far the current utility estimate is from the target

concepts.name: Gradiente dell'errore rispetto a θ (stato)
concepts.nameEn: The gradient of the error with respect to the function parameters θ

concepts.name: Aggiornamento SGD di θ per l'utilità di stato
concepts.nameEn: Using stochastic gradient descent (SGD), we update θ

concepts.name: Errore TD per l'utilità d'azione approssimata (Q-learning)
concepts.nameEn: TD Learning: Action Utility Approximation (Q-Learning). The TD error in this case

concepts.name: Gradiente dell'errore rispetto a θ (azione)
concepts.nameEn: The gradient of the error with respect to θ (action utility)

concepts.name: Aggiornamento SGD di θ per la Q
concepts.nameEn: Again, using stochastic gradient descent, we update θ

concepts.name: Il bersaglio è trattato come costante (semi-gradiente)
concepts.nameEn: The target R(s) + γU_θ(s') is treated as fixed when differentiating (semi-gradient)

concepts.name: Sintesi: l'approssimazione di funzione sostituisce le tabelle
concepts.nameEn: Key Takeaways: Function approximation replaces tabular representations, enabling reinforcement learning in large or continuous spaces

concepts.name: Sintesi: TD con discesa del gradiente per U o Q
concepts.nameEn: TD learning with gradient descent allows learning state utilities U(s) or action utilities Q(s, a) efficiently

concepts.name: Reti neurali per Q_θ: Deep Q-Networks (DQN)
concepts.nameEn: Neural networks and other machine learning models can be used to approximate Q_θ(s, a), leading to Deep Q-Networks (DQN)

concepts.name: Applicazioni: robotica, giochi (AlphaGo, OpenAI Five), decisioni reali
concepts.nameEn: This approach is widely used in robotics, games (e.g., AlphaGo, OpenAI Five), and real-world decision-making

concepts.name: Discesa del gradiente: definizione e obiettivo
concepts.nameEn: Gradient Descent is a fundamental optimization algorithm used to minimize the loss function of a neural network by iteratively adjusting its parameters

concepts.name: Direzione di massima discesa = gradiente negativo (il segno meno)
concepts.nameEn: direction of the steepest descent of the loss function; negative gradient

concepts.name: Vettore gradiente della loss rispetto ai parametri
concepts.nameEn: \Delta_w L: the change in the loss function L with respect to the parameters w

concepts.name: Derivata parziale della loss rispetto all'i-esimo parametro
concepts.nameEn: partial derivative of the loss function with respect to the i-th parameter w_i

concepts.name: Figura: le derivate parziali in 3D e nella vista dall'alto
concepts.nameEn: Visualization of Partial Derivatives in Two Distinct Ways

concepts.name: Il campo del gradiente indica la via più rapida per ridurre la loss
concepts.nameEn: This visualization is crucial for understanding how Gradient Descent finds the fastest direction to reduce loss and update model weights

concepts.name: Ogni derivata parziale misura quanto velocemente cambia la loss in una direzione
concepts.nameEn: Each partial derivative measures how fast the loss changes in one direction

concepts.name: Gradiente nullo: la loss non cambia in nessuna direzione
concepts.nameEn: When the gradient is zero, the loss is not changing in any direction

concepts.name: Figura: rappresentazione visiva dell'algoritmo della discesa del gradiente
concepts.nameEn: Visual Representation of the Gradient Descent Algorithm

concepts.name: Iterare fino a convergenza o fino a un numero prefissato di iterazioni
concepts.nameEn: The algorithm proceeds by iteratively updating the parameters according to the gradient direction until convergence is reached or a predefined number of iterations is completed

concepts.name: La discesa del gradiente naviga lo spazio dei parametri
concepts.nameEn: Gradient Descent effectively navigates the parameter space to find the optimal configuration that minimizes the loss function

concepts.name: Problema non convesso ed esistenza di minimi locali
concepts.nameEn: In neural networks, the optimization problem is non-convex, leading to the existence of local minima

concepts.name: I minimi locali sono spesso soluzioni efficaci
concepts.nameEn: practitioners have found that these local minima are often still effective solutions; local minima are not typically a significant concern in neural network training

concepts.name: Figura: minimi locali ('trappole') e minimo globale
concepts.nameEn: Local and Global Minima (Local Minima Trap, Global Minima)

concepts.name: Punto di sella: alcune direzioni curvano in su, altre in giù
concepts.nameEn: saddle points, where some directions curve upwards and others downwards

concepts.name: Nella sella il gradiente è nullo anche se il punto non è un minimo
concepts.nameEn: At a saddle point, the gradient is zero, even if the point is not a minimum

concepts.name: I punti di sella sono comuni in alta dimensione
concepts.nameEn: saddle points are common in high-dimensional spaces

concepts.name: Le selle sono un problema solo se l'algoritmo si blocca esattamente su di esse
concepts.nameEn: they only become problematic if the optimization algorithm becomes stuck exactly at the saddle point

concepts.name: Figura: illustrazione del punto di sella
concepts.nameEn: Saddle Point Illustration

concepts.name: Come si imparano i pesi: le idee che hanno preceduto la backpropagation
concepts.nameEn: How do we learn the weights of a neural network? Ideas that have guided the development of learning algorithms

concepts.name: Idea 1: perturbare a caso un peso alla volta
concepts.nameEn: randomly perturb one weight at a time

concepts.name: Idea 2: perturbare tutti i pesi simultaneamente
concepts.nameEn: perturbing all the weights simultaneously and correlating performance improvement with changes in the weights

concepts.name: Idea 3: perturbare solo le attivazioni
concepts.nameEn: perturb only the activations, which are fewer in number than the weights

concepts.name: Perché serve la backpropagation: un apprendimento più efficiente
concepts.nameEn: Therefore, how can we achieve more efficient learning? This is where backpropagation comes in.

concepts.name: Backpropagation: algoritmo in tre passi principali
concepts.nameEn: Backpropagation is a widely used learning algorithm in neural networks, which consists of three main steps

concepts.name: Passo 1: propagazione in avanti
concepts.nameEn: Forward Propagation: summation of inputs, production of activations and propagation of output through the network

concepts.name: Passo 2: stima dell'errore
concepts.nameEn: Error Estimation: comparison of labels with predictions obtained from the network

concepts.name: Passo 3: propagazione all'indietro del segnale d'errore e aggiornamento dei pesi
concepts.nameEn: Backpropagation of the error signal and using this signal to update the weights by computing gradients

concepts.name: Il comportamento ottimo delle unità nascoste non è noto dai dati
concepts.nameEn: Starting from the training data, we do not directly know the optimal behavior of the hidden units within the neural network

concepts.name: Le derivate dell'errore rispetto alle attività nascoste
concepts.nameEn: Using the derivatives of the error with respect to the hidden activities, we are able to understand how each hidden unit affects the overall error of the network

concepts.name: Dalle derivate sulle attività all'aggiornamento dei pesi di ogni connessione
concepts.nameEn: Once we have calculated the derivatives of the error with respect to the hidden activities, we gain valuable information to update the weights associated with each connection in the network

concepts.name: Backpropagation passo passo: dall'uscita all'ingresso, un neurone per strato
concepts.nameEn: Exploring backpropagation: step by step, starting with the output layer and proceeding to the input layer; one neuron per layer

concepts.name: Passo forward nella catena: dall'attivazione precedente alla loss
concepts.nameEn: After performing the forward step, we will get an output from the last activation a^(l), which will allow us to calculate the loss L using the desired output y

concepts.name: Equazioni del neurone: somma pesata z e attivazione a = σ(z)
concepts.nameEn: z^(l) = w^(l) a^(l-1) + b^(l); a^(l) = σ(z^(l)); z^(l) is the input of a non-linear function σ, such as a sigmoid or a ReLU

concepts.name: Figura: concettualizzazione dei calcoli (grafo delle dipendenze)
concepts.nameEn: Conceptualisation of Calculations

concepts.name: Obiettivo del passo backward: la sensibilità ∂L/∂w^(l)
concepts.nameEn: how sensitive the loss L is to small changes in the weight w^(l): how much does L (numerator) change if we make a small change at w^(l) (denominator)?

concepts.name: Catena causale w → z → a → L: entra in gioco la regola della catena
concepts.nameEn: a small change in weight w^(l) causes a change in z^(l), which in turn causes a change in a^(l), directly affecting the loss L; this is where the chain of derivatives rule comes into play

concepts.name: Scomposizione di ∂L/∂w^(l) in tre fattori (chain rule)
concepts.nameEn: we can now 'chunk' the previous derivative

concepts.name: Derivata rispetto al bias: stesso metodo del peso
concepts.nameEn: What about the bias term? Easy peasy! We use the same method as for the weight term

concepts.name: Figura: schema esteso a più strati
concepts.nameEn: Conceptualisation of Calculations (Extended)

concepts.name: Strati precedenti: prima la sensibilità all'attivazione del penultimo strato
concepts.nameEn: first consider how sensitive the cost is to the value of that activation in the penultimate layer, a^(l-1), and then consider how sensitive that value is to all the previous weights and biases

concepts.name: Derivata del costo rispetto all'attivazione precedente ∂L/∂a^(l−1)
concepts.nameEn: The derivative of cost with respect to that activation looks a lot like what we have already seen

concepts.name: Lunga catena di dipendenze tra w^(l−1) e la loss
concepts.nameEn: there is a long chain of dependencies between the weight w^(l-1) and the cost L; the partial derivative appears as a long chain of partial derivatives for each intermediate step

concepts.name: Scomposizione di ∂L/∂w^(l−1) con il fattore ∂L/∂a^(l−1) sotto la graffa
concepts.nameEn: Here is how you can decompose the derivative

concepts.name: Figura: calcoli con 3 strati
concepts.nameEn: Calculations with 3 Layers

concepts.name: Derivata del costo rispetto a qualunque peso o bias della rete
concepts.nameEn: we now can calculate the derivative of the cost with respect to any weight or bias of the entire network; we are simply applying the same idea of the chain rule

concepts.name: Vettore gradiente completo con pesi e bias di tutti gli strati
concepts.nameEn: since we can get any derivative, we can calculate the entire gradient vector

concepts.name: Più neuroni per strato: cambia poco, servono solo più indici
concepts.nameEn: The job is done! At least for this network ... not much changes when we give the layers more neurons: it's just a few more indexes to keep track of

concepts.name: Notazione: apice = strato, pedice = neurone
concepts.nameEn: the superscript of each neuron indicates which layer it is in, while the subscript indicates the specific neuron

concepts.name: Indici dei pesi w_ji^(l): dal neurone i dello strato l−1 al neurone j dello strato l
concepts.nameEn: two subscripts indicate the edge weight connecting the neuron in layer i to the neuron in layer j; these 'ji' indices align with the way the weight matrix is usually indexed

concepts.name: Figure: indicizzazione della rete ed esempio con strati 0 e 1
concepts.nameEn: Neural Network Indexing; Example of Indexing

concepts.name: Somma pesata con più neuroni per strato
concepts.nameEn: The weighted sum z_j^(l) then takes the following form

concepts.name: Derivata rispetto a w_ji: stessa forma del caso a un neurone
concepts.nameEn: The new equations turn out to be essentially the same with respect to the case of only one neuron per layer

concepts.name: Le attivazioni precedenti influenzano il costo attraverso più percorsi
concepts.nameEn: What changes is the derivative of the cost with respect to one of the activations in the preceding layers, because the preceding neurons influence the cost function through multiple pathways

concepts.name: Somma sui percorsi: ∂L/∂a_i^(l−1) come somma sullo strato l
concepts.nameEn: we sum multiple expressions of different chain rules corresponding to each pathway of influence (Sum over layer l)

concepts.name: Approccio matriciale per l'efficienza
concepts.nameEn: it is necessary to use the matrix approach, since it allows simultaneous operations to be performed on all the parameters of the network

concepts.name: Derivate locali esplicite dei fattori della catena (integrazione)
concepts.nameEn: local derivatives: dz/dw = a^(l-1), dz/db = 1, dz/da^(l-1) = w^(l), da/dz = σ'(z), dL/da for the squared error

concepts.name: Forma matriciale della backpropagation con il segnale d'errore δ (integrazione)
concepts.nameEn: matrix form of backpropagation: error signal δ = ∂L/∂z, gradient δ a^T, backward pass W^T δ

concepts.name: Prodotto di molti fattori: gradiente che svanisce o esplode (integrazione)
concepts.nameEn: vanishing / exploding gradient from long chains of partial derivatives

concepts.name: Due accezioni di 'backpropagation': metodo per calcolare i gradienti o algoritmo di apprendimento
concepts.nameEn: Backpropagation, a method for computing gradients (p. 16) vs Backpropagation is a widely used learning algorithm in neural networks, which consists of three main steps (p. 19)

concepts.name: Regola della catena: prodotto lungo un percorso, somma su più percorsi (richiamo, integrazione)
concepts.nameEn: chain rule ('the chain of derivatives rule comes into play'; 'the same idea of the chain rule that we have always used')
